name: Speyerer Weihnachts- und Neujahrsmarkt
note: 3D video show on the Altpörtel 18:00 + 20:00 (Fri/Sat also 21:00), ice rink
description: Christmas and New Year market between gate tower and cathedral
details:
Speyer's Christmas and New Year market runs from the medieval town gate Altpörtel down Maximilianstraße to the cathedral. Highlights: a 3D video show projected onto the Altpörtel (daily at 18:00 and 20:00, Friday and Saturday also at 21:00), an ice rink, the Christmas pyramid at the Stadthaus and a children's bakery.

Opening on Monday 23 November at 18:00 on the Geschirrplätzel. Stalls 11-20, food and drinks Sunday to Thursday 11-21, Friday and Saturday 11-22. Special hours over Christmas and New Year; closed 25-26 December. The market runs until 10 January 2027.
